project.name: MARS-RL
project.goal: Build an IEEE-Transactions-level research package on margin-trading deep RL for portfolio management, using Gu et al., "Incorporating Realistic Margin Constraints: A Data-Driven DRL Framework for Advanced Portfolio Management", IEEE TKDE 2026, DOI 10.1109/TKDE.2026.3701681 (authors' code: github.com/JingyiGu/Margin-Trader, MIT, pinned commit 7b7fa9e89d8c202b80778b4f1fa82353841cfd52) as the base paper. The user WANTS to beat the base paper's performance metrics. Honest status: NOT achieved yet (see results).

user.language: Hinglish (Hindi written in Latin script) + English technical terms
user.preference: Honest numbers only; plain tables; clear comparison vs base paper; do not generate extra files until results are final

base_paper.data: 28-30 DJIA stocks, Yahoo Finance, FinRL-Meta processing, daily
base_paper.costs: 0.1% transaction cost only (no slippage, no borrow or financing cost in their simulator)

table_I.source: PDF page 8 (journal p.5916), PPO rows; test period

base_paper.target: Sharpe above 1.05-1.16 and annual return above 19-31% on the same test window = "beat the paper"

results_so_far.costs: Track B common costs unless stated

model.name: v2_b REFIT ensemble (train+val, 5 seeds) BEST SO FAR

track_a.note: authors' OWN code on our data, zero slippage; NOT comparable to Track B

results_so_far.conclusion: Not beating the base paper: best Sharpe 0.85 vs 1.05-1.16; return 11.3% vs 19-31%. Matches equal-weight Sharpe, lower drawdown and cost-robust, zero margin calls. Authors' public code only reaches 11.1% on our data (paper reports 30.9%), so the paper's headline numbers did not reproduce. Supervised alpha (ridge/GBM) had validation rank-IC about 0 (-0.036..+0.014) on the 28-stock feature set, i.e. no out-of-sample predictive edge in those features.

architecture.name: MARS-RL
architecture.component: Constrained-MDP PPO experts (long, long-short, neutral) with learned leverage L = Lmax*(a+1)/2, Lagrangian dual ascent on margin-call and drawdown-excess costs
Conformal exposure guard at execution: score |r_EW,t|/sigma_EW,t-1 (EWMA 0.94), rolling 95% quantile over 250d, scale = min(1, B/(q*sqrt(w'Sigma w)))
Regime-switching block-bootstrap digital twin (train-only data; 3 vol regimes, Markov chain, geometric blocks mean 10; crash stress drift -0.15%/day vol x1.3)
Retrieval-guided mixture-of-experts gate (kNN on market-state embedding, 20d forward expert Sharpe, outcome embargo)
Residual policy around equal weight (mode 'resid', kappa tilt), execution smoothing, turnover penalty -> big gain over v1
LLM/agentic news layer; Mamba encoder; distillation student; causal module
architecture.simulator: Track B: decision at close t, execute at open t+1, fee 0.1% + slippage 2bp per side, borrow 0.5%/yr, loan 4%/yr, margin warning 40% / call 30% -> liquidate to 50% + 0.1% fee, initial equity 100000, ruin at 20%

protocol.rule: Train on train range; choose design and checkpoint on VALIDATION only; run the test window once per final configuration.
Never tune on test. Count every variant tried (n_trials) and report it. Disclose that test was peeked once in v1 stage-1 smoke test.
Report negative results as measured. Do not claim "beats paper" unless the locked test shows it with seeds/CI.
Keep Track A (authors' simulator) and Track B (our common-cost simulator) separate; never compare their numbers directly.
Point-in-time features only: feature(t) uses data up to close of day t; macro/fundamentals use release lags. Unit test exists (tests/test_core.py).
protocol.variants_tried_after_v1: v2_a..v2_f (6), v3_a..v3_d (4), v4_a..v4_b (2); final = v2_b refit on train+val; plus alpha-IC experiment

new_dataset.status: User downloaded it with colab/MARS_RL_mega_dataset_downloader.ipynb (produces mars_data/ folder + zip). NOT yet inspected or used by any code.
new_dataset.contents: S&P500+DJIA stocks 2000-2024 OHLCV adjusted; ETFs; crypto; FRED macro (release-lagged); Fama-French 5 factors + momentum; CBOE VIX family + SKEW; optional earnings/fundamentals; optional FNSPID news
new_dataset.caveat: S&P 500 list is today's membership: survivorship bias, must be disclosed.

first_tasks.task: Inspect data_quality.json; check coverage, NaNs, splits/outliers
Rank-IC test of a supervised alpha on the NEW features with train-only fit and embargo (src/alpha.py); decide go/no-go on RL
Choose a liquid fixed-size universe (e.g. top 50-100 by dollar volume with full history) and add macro/FF/CBOE as market-state features in src/data.py
Retrain v2_b-style residual PPO ensemble; select on validation; refit train+val; test once; compare to base paper table
Only then regenerate tables, figures, README, manuscript, notebook

known_pitfalls.item: Background jobs die when the session pauses: use resumable scripts (scripts/run_stage.sh skips finished runs).
Observation size scales with N stocks * F features; 500 stocks needs a sampling or selection layer.
Seed variance is large (val Sharpe per seed 0.6-1.5); always use multi-seed ensembles.
Validation window is only 16 months: selection is noisy; prefer rolling/walk-forward validation on the longer new history.
With 2000-2008 data available, train/val/test splits can be redesigned (several test windows) - document any change as a new protocol.
